messages.author: 120aaddd58a60b60
messages.subject: Re: Uncaught exception: Error: Bad Request
parts:
Hi Joe, 

Yes, nodejs is v0.10.4. 

The only other thing that I can add is that my app uses RJDBC to connect to MS SQL server. At the moment the crash happened I had a particular complex query that took about 30 sec to execute; I noticed a crash or two that was happening in the app (not the shiny-server) esp. when several users were trying to refresh the query independently. Since I memorized the query I saw no more crashes yet. 

Any other information or logs I can provide to make it easier to debug?

Thanks for looking into this,
Victor
